description: Suijin v3.11.0: PHASE 3 COMPLETE — all 49 Modules/ packs convert to kernel plugins (pack_converter generates plugin.json + entry shims; flat layout, category kept as metadata). Full OS boot with packs: 61 modules, packs own their 93 tools (tools module owns the 31 core routes); pack-less boots bridge everything, behavior identical. Pack ownership decided by the BOOT (booted-unit stamp), not ambient discovery. 990 tests green (125 kernel).
